counting.note: 31+4 HTTP and +1 resource are counted separately; the adjunct is not added to the frozen registry.

pagination.sort: asset_id ASCII for inventory; stable Host source candidate ordering for source-files
pagination.cursor: opaque server-held token bound to principal/project/operation/filter/root-generation; expires after 900 seconds; stale cursor 410, never silently continue new generation

source_candidate.identity: Host opaque per-principal/project/root-generation and regular-file identity token; no absolute paths or raw directory controls accepted
source_candidate.selection: safe configured sourceRoot only; symlinks/escape/unconfigured forbidden; no J scan
source_candidate.hash: only selected file hashed before import; no hashing entire directory in GET
source_candidate.registration: Host resolves candidate to private relative_path, computes expected_sha256, rechecks identity, sets attestation_ref from trusted session, then invokes existing LocalAssetRegistry.import

idempotency.authority: existing operation_idempotency for LocalAssetRegistry import; no second command state
idempotency.attestation_ref: ui_ + first60hex(SHA256(domain narralens-local-asset-declaration-v1 newline + canonical public_digest preimage))
idempotency.lookup_order: current auth/owner+public schema -> recall original import operation receipt by same project/key and verify response asset/operator/declaration ref -> return original InventoryItem if matching -> otherwise validate candidate/expiry/root/file and construct original LocalAssetInput
idempotency.same_key_different_public_input: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT even if candidate expired; never replay an unrelated declaration
idempotency.same_key_success_after_expiry_or_restart: replay original authenticated import receipt without requiring candidate cache; do not reopen/re-probe source input or generate new attestation ref
idempotency.no_receipt: candidate must still be valid; hash current selected bytes; import with deterministic attestation ref; no random per-retry declared identity
idempotency.scope: public wrapper private registry method may read only original typed import receipt/LocalAsset; never arbitrary operation responses

rights_ref: id=real asset.rights_ref; version=1; sha256=registration_digest; row/project/bytes/license must still validate

errors.403: wrong channel or Origin, runtime scope not allowed
errors.410: candidate/cursor expired or root generation moved
errors.503: unconfigured root, unsupported media/tool, transient resource exhaustion; retryable truth preserved

registration_owner: MAIN publishes explicit adjunct allowlist and merges runtime discovery; not added to frozen registry resources

side_effects.POST: only verified blob/LocalAsset/idempotency/outbox, never Run grant/Approval/author/revision
